qualification.ideal_customer_description: An Arizona fire-protection company doing sprinkler, fire-extinguisher, fire-alarm, or backflow inspections. Recurring compliance contracts. Owner-run, technicians in the field, calls missed while on jobs. Dated or minimal website.
qualification.service_focus: an AI receptionist built for fire-protection companies that answers every call 24/7, books inspections straight onto the calendar, and automatically follows up on expiring sprinkler/alarm/extinguisher certifications

custom_guidelines: Do NOT use phrases like 'I hope this email finds you well'
Lead with the recurring-contract angle - a missed call is a lost recurring inspection contract, not a one-off
Reference compliance/AHJ deadlines and expiring certifications as the pressure point
Reference specific pain: calls missed while techs are out on inspections, slow follow-up on renewal-due accounts
